# Definitional

This folder contains topics related to the precise clinical and operational definitions used to measure hospital performance and patient care quality within the Acute Database (AKDB). It documents the strict criteria applied to clinical indicators, such as the exact timeframes for surgical wait times and post-operative mobilization, as well as the appropriate use of medical classification codes to ensure consistent benchmarking across healthcare facilities.

## Pages

- [[definitional|Definitional]] — Details the strict clinical and operational criteria for AKDB indicators, including surgical wait times, post-operative mobilization, and the correct application of medical codes.
